description: Principal PM-posture skill that cuts an idea — something said in passing, a note, or a seed that someone else set down — into 根回し Nemawashi seeds, each one walkable on its own, each with an owning project and its own station checklist, written into that project's candidate pool. Requires Principal PM posture and halts outside a principal-pm session or the principal-pm subagent. It opens no worktree and no branch — it writes and commits in the instance it was started in, so the seeds are in the pool the moment the run ends. The cut itself never interviews — when it meets something the repository cannot settle it commits what it has written, names the case, and halts there, so a re-run folds that work instead of cutting the idea again from nothing. Use when an idea needs cutting into seeds, when a discussion or a note should become seeded work, or when an unstructured ask has to end up as seeds a PM can pick.
